evidence_conflicts.text: The step-A continuation states CdS crystallites grow to 3.5 nm, while the subsequent common system description and Figure 1 use 3.2 nm CdS cores. Neither is silently corrected or averaged. The source does not resolve whether this reflects a preparation variation, measurement difference or typographical error.
